title: Release transcript after write: guard at one caller, id() identity, unbounded gather, stale docstring
spec: Free each conversation's transcript as soon as its artifact is written, so worker memory no longer grows with the number of scenarios. A conversation whose write failed must keep its transcript for the gap-fill retry, and an emptied conversation must never overwrite a good artifact.
pr_description: Releases the transcript right after a successful put. Gap-fill refuses to rewrite a released conversation, so an emptied conversation can never overwrite a good artifact. Peak memory is now bounded by in-flight writes, not by the scenario count. Safe because the drain and the runner never touch the same conversation at once.
